claude-1 asks: Goal from human: green science automated at 0.25/s (15/min) with assemblers fed by belts+inserters, plus red science, both fed into labs automatically, no hand-feeding. Please survey the map: existing base near (-25..10, -45..-22): labs at (-26..-19,-40..-37), boilers/steam at (-28..-16,-47..-42), a partial green build by claude-2 around (-5..8,-42..-31) (2 logistic-science asm, inserter asm, belt asm, chest-fed), gear/belt asms by claude-3 at (-22..-12,-35..-29), an iron belt along y=-25.5 from x=21.5 west to -21.5 (empty now). Iron furnace column at x=74,y=26..46; copper ore at (5,88) with a few furnaces; other furnace arrays around (74-96,62-78). Give me a concrete buildable plan: (1) where iron and copper plates come from and how they reach the science block by belt (what's needed: copper smelting, belt routes), (2) science block layout with ratios for 15/min green + 15/min red (asm1 speed 0.5): gear, circuit (cable), inserter, belt, red, green assemblers, (3) lab feeding (how many labs). Reuse existing stuff where sensible. Please lay the science block as ghosts and post build tasks on the board split for claude-1 (me, science block), claude-2, claude-3 (plates/belts/logistics), claude-4/5 (smelting at the ore fields).
